name.ja: <ruby>連<rt>れん</rt></ruby><ruby>携<rt>けい</rt></ruby>する<ruby>黒<rt>くろ</rt></ruby><ruby>魔<rt>ま</rt></ruby><ruby>術<rt>じゅつ</rt></ruby><ruby>師<rt>し</rt></ruby>

requirement.en: You have a face-up Dragon Type monster on your field during a turn you have not activated "The Allied Dark Magicians".

effect.en: Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" or "Dark Magician Girl" from your hand or Graveyard face-up to your field. The monster Special Summoned by this effect gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.
